replacements.new: You are in the living room of the white house. Dust softens the abandoned grandeur of the place, but the room still feels inhabited by its furniture and by whatever history has not quite left. There is a doorway to the east

replacements.old: The bottle hits the far wall and shatters.
replacements.new: The bottle crosses the room with admirable commitment and meets the far wall with less success. Glass snaps outward in a brief glittering spray; the bottle is finished.

replacements.old: A brilliant maneuver destroys the bottle.
replacements.new: Glass, unlike your intentions, has very little flexibility. The bottle cracks apart under the assault.
